content_data.meeting_title: Video Streaming CDN Performance Optimization - Sprint Planning & Architecture Review
agenda_items: Review current CDN latency metrics across European regions
Plan infrastructure scaling approach for peak viewing hours
Evaluate caching strategy for live broadcast events
key_decisions: Migrate from Redis to Memcached for session management to reduce memory overhead by 30%
Implement edge computing nodes in Frankfurt and Amsterdam within the next 3 months
